0x0007A9.en: 「As I am now...@ this is my limit...!」

0x00081A.en: 「Guh!@ So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008A2.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x00091C.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000A03.en: 「Oh dear...@ how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000ACC.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B07.en: 「No way I'm losing here...!@ This is no fun...」

0x000B5B.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000BCF.en: 「Guh! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000CAC.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is yours.」

0x000D58.en: 「No good, took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000DA5.en: 「I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DE3.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000E2A.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000ED5.en: 「Ngh... so I'm the falling star now... Ejecting!」

0x000FCD.en: 「Oh brother, they went and got me!」

0x001011.en: 「U...nngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x00107E.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010C5.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x0010FA.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x0011E6.en: 「To be taken out here...@　I still have so much to learn...!」

0x001234.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! I'm pulling back!」

0x0012AD.en: 「Sorry, guys!@　I'm gonna have to bow out...!」

0x0012EF.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x00131E.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00135C.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x00138B.en: 「I can't go on like this. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x0013DE.en: 「Damn it... I'll have to fall back.」

0x001416.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull out for now...!」

0x00163A.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0017A9.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0018CE.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Novus State, Dunk City

0x00190E.en: 「These red areas are under Shutedonias's control.@ It looks like they've taken many states, the@ capital included, but...」

0x0019BC.en: 「In truth, it's control by lines.@　They're merely connecting point to point.」

0x001A18.en: 「If the Kirkus army severs those lines,@　the situation should change completely.」

0x001A71.en: 「So the blue areas are the parts of Langran not yet@　invaded, and the yellow is under the Kirkus army...」

0x001AF4.en: 「So right now, we're smack in the middle@　of enemy territory.」

0x001B4A.en: 「Other Langran forces should still be resisting@ elsewhere, but with the capital taken, reports@ are scattered and unclear.」

0x001C62.en: 「But soon the Kirkus army will begin its advance on@　Troia State. Gennacy and I intend to draw out the@　enemy forces stationed in Quate City.」

0x001D8E.en: 「Quate City is currently a linchpin of the Shutedonias@　army's supply line. Strike here, and the enemy@　will be thrown off balance.」

0x001E27.en: 「A linchpin of their supply line, huh...@　Then they'll have a fair amount of forces there.」

0x001EAB.en: 「Lune, what will you do?@　There's no need to force yourselves to join, but...」

0x001F13.en: 「Beats just sitting around waiting. I'm in.」

0x001F56.en: 「...Seems liberating Langran is the fastest way to find@　the scattered folks and get back to the surface.」

0x001FEC.en: 「Kyosuke, I'm thinking of lending Yang Long a hand.@　What about you?」

0x0020A1.en: 「All right, let's head to Quate City.」

0x002107.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Liston State, Quate City

0x002147.en: 「And here I wondered what kind of recon it'd be...@　Peeping? How old-fashioned.」

0x0021A9.en: 「Well, it's been the pattern lately.@　But Ranshao's a real help. She scurries around@　and gathers all kinds of information.」

0x00224B.en: 「If she could shapeshift on top of that, she'd be like...」

0x0022CC.en: 「Besides Seiso Kishi like the Goliath and Nagrod,@　there's one Sodium-class vessel.」

0x00235F.en: 「A mobile ground fortress used across the nations of@　<La Gias>, capable of carrying several Seiso Kishi.」

0x002412.en: 「Sounds like the perfect match for Jaohm.」

0x00246B.en: 「Then our forces should be able to handle it.@　Let's move in.」

0x0024BB.en: 「Enemy attack!?@　There shouldn't be any concentrated Langran forces@　around these parts!」

0x002546.en: 「Well, sir... it's surface mobile weapons and a Seiso Kishin.」

0x002592.en: 「A <Seiso Kishin>?@　Don't tell me it's that Granveil, the one Lieutenant@　Radius reported on?」

0x002634.en: 「Oh, brother... a real nuisance turned up. If I'd known,@　I'd have rushed the transfer of that thing.」

0x0026B7.en: 「And the number of surface mechs has grown, too...@　They're actively recruiting surface-dwellers as well.」

0x00273A.en: 「...I am Huang Yang Long, pilot of the Seiso Kishin@　Granveil. Cease your invasion of Langran and@　leave at once.」

0x0027E2.en: 「Invasion? Now that you mention it, true enough...」

0x00282F.en: 「Ah, no... hrm, that's not it at all.@　We're the ones in the right, no question.」

0x00289A.en: 「In the right? You exploit a terror attack on the@　capital to wage a war of aggression, and you say that?」

0x002917.en: 「If Langran hadn't gone and built things like the Seiso@　Kishin, we would never have invaded in the first place!」

0x002994.en: 「Weapons like those are a threat by their very existence!@　We only did what was natural to protect our own nation!」

0x002A2C.en: 「The Seiso Kishin are not weapons for invading others.@　They're power to counter the foretold calamity of <La Gias>.」

0x002AEE.en: 「Enough, Captain Grasnof.@　Arguing over who's in the right gets us nowhere.@　In the end, this is war.」

0x002B9F.en: 「We fight to protect our own nation, our families.@　That's reason enough.」

0x002C0A.en: 「Heh... that old man's@　got some real grit to him.」

0x002C57.en: 「...Then there's no need for further talk.@　We settle this in battle!」

0x002CBC.en: 「...Captain Grasnof, contact the other units.@　Tell them we don't need reinforcements here.」

0x002D30.en: 「Why!? We can't just hand Quate over to them!」

0x002D92.en: 「They're a diversion. The enemy's real target is another@　base. Though... it may already be too late.」

0x002E1E.en: 「...Just like Lieutenant Radius said. These guys are@ strong. No choice, then - all we can do now@ is retreat.」

0x002EDC.en: 「Don't underestimate a Seiso Kishin.@　Better for us down the line to go out and take@　that thing for certain ourselves.」

0x002FBF.en: 「No need to pursue.@　Ranshao, get me a line to General Kirkus.」

0x00301B.en: 「As you wish, Master.@　There's a disturbance in the ether flow, so it@　may take a little time.」

0x0030BB.en: 「...By the way, Yang Long.@　That foretold calamity of La Gias you mentioned@　earlier. What is it?」

0x003158.en: 「Master, the line to General Kirkus is connected.」

0x003231.en: 「Well done.@　We succeeded in retaking Troia State as well.」

0x00328A.en: 「That's wonderful news.@　And has any word come in about Princess Monica?」

0x003339.en: 「I'll send the next request later.@　Until then, get some rest.」

0x0033DD.en: 「Seiso Kishin or not, it's not invincible!@　Let 'em have it!」

0x003467.en: 「I heard the reports, but it's one truly bizarre machine.@　Still, I'll grant it's a beauty.」

0x003509.en: 「Ha, you're easily flattered, aren't you?@　Then maybe I'll try killing you with kindness.」

0x00356E.en: 「General, this is no time for that sort of thing!」

0x0035E5.en: 「That they succeeded in retaking Troia State.@　This changes the tide of the war considerably.」

0x00366F.en: 「Standby for a while.@　The general said to get some rest, though.」

0x0036BF.en: 「Huh, more considerate than I'd have thought.」

0x0036F6.en: 「So, back to what we were saying.@　What's this calamity of La Gias?」

0x00374C.en: 「Some time ago, a seer of the Langran Royal Academy@　made this prophecy.」

0x0037B1.en: 「'A colossal demon god shall destroy Langran.@　And it shall scatter calamity upon all living@　things in La Gias.' ...So it went.」

0x00386C.en: 「And as the means to oppose it, the development of@　the <Seiso Kishi> and <Seiso Kishin> was decided.」

0x0038EA.en: 「They went that far over something as vague@　as a prophecy...?」

0x003949.en: 「Prophecy in this world isn't like that of the surface.」

0x003986.en: 「Right, its reliability is high.@ But a prophecy is only a possibility -@ people have the power to change it.」

0x003A10.en: 「That's precisely why the <Seiso Kishi> and <Seiso Kishin> were made.」

0x003A9A.en: 「The Seiso Kishi are so capable that they have a flaw:@　only people with high <Prana> can operate them.」

0x003B26.en: 「But few in <La Gias> have Prana fierce enough for@ a Seiso Kishi pilot... so we had to summon@ candidates from the surface.」

0x003BF7.en: 「And so Gennacy, Masaki, and I were@　called from the surface into this world.」

0x003C8A.en: 「No, this summoning has things that don't add up.@ Some, like you, were summoned with the machines@ you piloted. Others weren't, I hear.」

0x003D53.en: 「I think Masaki said he was called to La Gias@　with just the clothes on his back...」

0x003DC1.en: 「So this time the summoning was@　pretty haphazard, you're saying?」

0x003E1D.en: 「I don't know who engineered it, but...@　I suspect it was closer to an accident.」

0x003E97.en: 「What the hell. Talk about a nuisance.」

0x003EC5.en: 「Hey, Yang Long.@　You said there are four <Seiso Kishin>, right?@　Granveil and Cybuster... what are the others?」

0x003F63.en: 「The water Kishin Gaddess and earth Kishin@ Zamzeed are both piloted by surface-dwellers...@ though Zamzeed's pilot Ricardo has died...」

0x00405D.en: 「Yes...@　Were he here, the situation would be different.」

0x0040B0.en: 「...So piloting a Seiso Kishin in this world@　carries a special meaning.」

0x004121.en: 「Don't tell me Masaki's@　some kind of celebrity around here?」

0x00417D.en: 「...That's right.@　He was even granted the holy title@　Randall Zan Zenosakis, once.」

0x004201.en: 「Huh, that Masaki, of all people... feels so strange...」
